title: Sports Physical Packet Request Form
subtitle: Capture packet source, examination reference, signature status, and restriction; confirm submission date and roster clearance.
description: Sports Physical Packet records packet source, examination reference, signature status, restriction, submission date, and roster clearance. Sports Physical Packet evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this sports physical packet request intake when staff must document packet source and examination reference. Reconcile signature status, restriction, submission date, and roster clearance before the sports physical packet handoff. Use the packet checklist, examination reference, required signatures, restriction insert, submission receipt, missing-page request, review stamp, and roster eligibility update. This packet centers document completeness: examination page, clinician signature, restriction attachment, parent page, school receipt, missing-page chase, review stamp, and roster release. Ask the assigned sports physical packet reviewer to confirm packet source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Sports Physical Packet requester details review
sections.guidance: Track examination reference, required packet pages, qualified signatures, restriction sheet, submission date, missing document, and roster clearance. Keep any urgent sports physical packet issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.guidance: Separate the requested outcome from constraints and optional items.

blocks.label: Sports Physical Packet request checks
items: Packet source is identified for this record
Examination reference matches the current request or source
Signature status is ready for point-of-use staff
Restriction limits or questions are resolved
Submission date is communicated to the responsible person
Roster clearance is confirmed at handoff

sections.title: Sports Physical Packet decision and response
sections.guidance: Record the authorized response without promising an unapproved outcome.
